findings.description: Native full and linear decoder graphs and their scalar references normalized the attention output before adding the residual.
Qwen-specific fixtures used adjacent-pair RoPE and a geometry that could not distinguish it from the required split-half pairing.
Qwen 3.5 conversion configs selected the Gemma sandwich-norm runtime route instead of the existing residual-before-pre-FFN-norm route.

requiredGates: clean corrected native GPU oracle suite
rank-32 Transformers Gamma versus Doppler microstep parity
distinct v2 F16 and mixed-Q4 manifests
v2 F16 Transformers boundary and logit parity
v2 mixed-Q4 attribution after the F16 control passes
adapter activation only after coherent base inference
claimBoundary: This receipt corrects and invalidates overbroad v1 architecture claims. It does not yet prove corrected GPU parity, base inference correctness, adapter correctness, native sustained training, WGSL capability, or runtime performance.
